verificationNotes: All final evidence uses the same artistic pack SHA. Earlier head/gaze-inclusive draft runs were stopped and are not counted.
Uniqueness was strengthened to require different limb/torso joint layouts, not just a different gaze; the final closest pair differs by 25 degrees after optimal actor matching.
Independent upright figures are listed before recumbent figures to avoid legacy partner-support inference without modifying the solver.

The complete 1283-scene render inventory uses the existing mesh pipeline and renderer directly at 256x192, without worker surface refinement, final occlusion or shadows. Ten representative scenes cover every authored base, gesture, body type and participant count through the full application worker.
The source index, earlier 203-scene approximation pack, stock presets, solver, worker, renderer and model assets remain unchanged.
limits: Original artistic interpretations, not source-matched reconstruction or 1283 hand-sculpted base poses.
87 compositions have coarse support gaps over 40 mm. Renderability and distinct geometry do not certify anatomy, support, balance, precise mesh separation or clothing fit.
The historical full unit suite was not rerun, and the full-worker path was not traversed for every composition. Physical-device and assistive-technology certification are not claimed.
No original source imagery, cloud service, new dependency or hosted deployment. Personal library contents are not changed by installing the built-in collection.
